text:

with the responsibility...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: ...of finding the most worthy person.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Well, I did.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: The money's gone.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:

Richard, the urologist.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Oh, it must be exciting work.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Going out on those expeditions,
digging around for fossils.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Listen, Mary Jo, you're a very...
Whew.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
- Healthy girl and all,
but I'm afraid even I need more than that.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Language.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:

and that's fine...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...but I'm afraid
I can't see you socially anymore.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Well, if that's the way you feel.

text: It is.

text: Well, I've got some work to do.

text: Bye.

text: Worked like a charm, Selma.

text:

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Thanks for tipping me off.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Hey, us foxes have gotta stick together,
don't we?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Pentimento.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I love that word.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:

when your surface rubbed off.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
The most numerous
examples of pentimento...

text:

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I know.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Shall we discuss it over some cognac?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Say, at my place after work?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Good God, yes.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Heh-heh.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Yeah.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:

$3 million in my hand.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: And gave it away.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Yeah, I'm gonna see a doctor about that.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Come on, we're happy the way we are.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Aren't we?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Sure.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I make it big, I spend it big.

text: I'm in for 2 cents.

text: And I'll see it.

text: And raise you $5000.

text: Grandpa will cover it.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Yeah?

text: - Hi, everyone.

text: - Oh, Leo.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Leo.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - How you doing?

text: - I want you to meet Arnie Prince.

text:
He's got a way
to help me spend my money.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Oh. I don't wanna hear this.

text: - Sure you do.

text:

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:

into my Broadway musical.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
It's what I've always wanted to do,
bring lots of smiles to lots of people.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Well, that's terrific, Leo.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - What's the play called?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Mussolini: The Man and His Music.

text:
Well, Leo,
we wish you all the success in the world.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Thanks. It's money in the bank.
